declared_input_scope: Two-stage deterministic JavaScript generation with ordinary non-indexed Source Maps and explicit GeneratedOrigin prior-support bridges.
candidate_path: stage-1 and stage-2 Core direct bindings -> GeneratedOrigin bridges -> compose_core_relations
reference_path: native stage-1 and stage-2 maps -> independent official SourceMapConsumer composition
multiplicity_semantics: Every composed mapping has a two-binding path; derived paths are not GenerationBinding entities and receive no fabricated gb3_ identity.
canonicalization_rules: Final-to-original records are ordered by final generated position and compared field-for-field.
output_orthogonality_rules: Both stage outputs remain byte-identical across output-only, native, Core, and dual modes.
authority_rules: Core composition follows only validated direct bindings and GeneratedOrigin prior_support_id bridges; native composition reads only the two native maps.
